x: A factory object that creates `WebGLStencilParameters` configuration objects.These objects describe the complete stencil buffer state required by theWebGL renderer, covering the stencil test function, per-operation behaviour,and the value used to clear the stencil buffer. Use this factory wheneveryou need to define or reset stencil state for a render pass.

m.x: Creates a new `WebGLStencilParameters` object that encapsulates the fullstencil buffer configuration for a WebGL render pass. The returned objectgroups the arguments into the three sub-objects expected by the renderer:`func` (passed to `gl.stencilFunc`), `op` (passed to `gl.stencilOp`), and`clear` (the value written when the stencil buffer is cleared). Allparameters are optional and fall back to sensible no-op defaults so thestencil buffer behaves as if it were disabled.

p.x: The WebGLRenderer to create the WebGLStencilParameters for.
Whether the stencil test is enabled.
The stencil comparison function used to compare the reference value against the current stencil buffer value.
The reference value against which the stencil buffer value is compared during the stencil test.
The bitwise mask applied to both the reference value and the stencil buffer value before they are compared.
The operation to perform if the stencil test fails.
The operation to perform if the stencil test passes but the depth test fails.
The operation to perform if the stencil test passes and the depth test passes or is disabled.
The value to clear the stencil buffer to.
The mask applied to the stencil buffer value when it is written. Set to 0 to prevent writing. Set to 0xFF to allow full writing.
